title: Radio and Television Production
topics: Radio as a medium and its formats

items.q: Cyclorama may be defined as
o: a short signature sequence that announces which outlet is on air
a smooth curved backdrop that gives an even, shadowless field behind the action
a sideways turn of the camera on a fixed base
the movement of viewers from one programme to the next on a channel
items.s: Cyclorama: a smooth curved backdrop that gives an even, shadowless field behind the action. The other options describe Pan, Audience flow, Station ident.

items.q: The statement “the evening hours when the largest audience is available to watch” describes which of the following?
o: Commissioning
Daypart
Prime time
Counter-programming
items.s: Prime time is the evening hours when the largest audience is available to watch.

items.q: Reality programme may be defined as
o: an estimate of all costs a programme will incur before work begins
a scripted play performed with voices, music and effects but no pictures
the total number of homes or persons in the population being measured
unscripted entertainment built around ordinary people placed in constructed situations
items.s: Reality programme: unscripted entertainment built around ordinary people placed in constructed situations. The other options describe Radio drama, Production budget, Universe estimate.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Playout?
o: existing recordings drawn from a store and reused in a new programme
the automatic or manual release of prepared material in running order
the catalogued store of recordings from which a station selects its tracks
the senior officer responsible for the whole running of a broadcast outlet
items.s: Playout: the automatic or manual release of prepared material in running order. The other options describe Station manager, Music library, Archive footage.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Long shot?
o: a framing that shows a whole figure or scene from a distance
a dark scheme with deep shadows and strong contrast, used for tension
to take down and clear a set once recording in it has finished
a humorous series with a fixed cast whose stories are resolved within each episode
items.s: Long shot: a framing that shows a whole figure or scene from a distance. The other options describe Strike, Low key lighting, Situation comedy.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Game show.
o: official permission to record at a site granted by its owner or the authorities
to take down and clear a set once recording in it has finished
a contest in which contestants answer questions or play for prizes before an audience
the movement of viewers from one programme to the next on a channel
items.s: Game show: a contest in which contestants answer questions or play for prizes before an audience. The other options describe Audience flow, Filming permit, Strike.

items.q: Which term is described by “official permission to record at a site granted by its owner or the authorities”?

Production budget
Location recce
Production meeting
items.s: Filming permit is official permission to record at a site granted by its owner or the authorities.
